title: Peer-led, Mobile App Supported Linkage to Opioid Use Disorder Treatment
official: mPeer4Life: A Peer-led, Mobile Health-supported, Narrative-based Intervention to Enhance Linkage and Engagement in Medication Assisted Treatment (MAT) for Patients With Opioid Use Disorder (OUD)
summary:
This is the third phase of the mPeer4Life study - the Trial Phase, will be evaluating the intervention that was developed based on the Formative and Pilot Phases. The study population are patients transitioning from the Emergency Department (ED) or hospital to outpatient Medication Assisted Treatment (MAT). The RCT will consist of three arms (1:1:1) with 30 participants in each arm:

* Arm 1 will include a peer navigator + mobile phone-assisted intervention
* Arm 2 will have a peer navigator only
* Arm 3 will follow the standard of care referral for MAT linkage All patient-level participants will complete baseline and exit interviews, which will evaluate current drug use behaviors, medical history, and OUD treatment engagement status.

interventions.name: Standard of care referral for out-patient MAT

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Opioid use-related ED or hospital encounter within one month of enrollment
* Self-report or documented illegal opioid drug use or prescription opioid misuse within one month of seeking care at ED or hospital

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non-English speaking
* Unwilling to adhere to study procedures
* Significant cognitive or auditory impairment that prevents proper completion of study procedures
